description: This Java class 'EmailServiceImpl' provides email-related business logic including sending HTML emails, retrieving email configurations, and saving email configuration settings within a Spring-based application. It implements the 'EmailService' interface and interacts with other components such as 'MerchantConfigurationService', 'HtmlEmailSender', and uses Jackson for JSON processing.

classes.name: EmailServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of email-related services including sending emails and managing email configurations, annotated as a Spring Service.

methods.name: sendHtmlEmail
methods.description: Sends an HTML email using configured email settings for a specific merchant store.

methods.name: getEmailConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves email configuration for a merchant store by parsing stored JSON configuration.

methods.name: saveEmailConfiguration
methods.description: Saves or updates email configuration settings for a merchant store.
